title: Layout
description: Headings, labels, roles and JSON pointers into one record type. It holds no values.

statuses.description: The record's own statuses, read beside its kind and date. Only status slots.

sections.description: Headed groups of fields, in reading order.

heading.description: The group's heading. A repeated group reads under its element's own code when it has one.

repeat.description: A JSON pointer to an array in the record. The section repeats once per element, and each slot's pointer is relative to that element.

label.description: What the value means. Never the value itself.

role.description: What part the value plays in the record.

pointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON pointer to one string, number or boolean in the record.
